title: Wikidot XML-RPC installed environment manifest v1
description: Canonical, host-absolute-path-free identity for a declared root-relative regular-file application-dependency capsule image that a later private capsule must materialize before launching the fixed XML-RPC worker. The scope declaration is not proof of complete runtime closure: this manifest binds the Python executable and pyvenv.cfg roles but does not by itself attest the system loader or base Python runtime.

files.description: The root-relative regular files to materialize. Symlinks and special filesystem objects are not representable in v1.

file.description: One regular file materialized inside the private capsule.

relativePath.description: A relative slash-separated path with no dot segment, backslash, or ASCII control character. The runtime validator additionally enforces a 4,096 UTF-8-byte limit and at most 32 segments.

x-runtime-validation: File paths are unique and no file path is an ancestor of another file path.
Canonical file entries are ordered by ascending UTF-8 path bytes.
Entries represent regular files only. A collector/materializer must reject source symlinks and special files, or independently copy a verified safe referent into a regular file before emitting v1.
The sum of file bytes is at most 4,294,967,296 and canonical encoded bytes are at most 16,777,216.
python_executable_path and venv_config_path are distinct declared files; the Python executable is executable and pyvenv.cfg is not executable.
The path byte and depth limits are measured by the runtime validator, not JSON Schema character counts.
